title: Filtering the products table by text · part 4

steps.title: Keep rows where created_at is 2025-09-20
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like '2025-09-20'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM products WHERE created_at = '2025-09-20';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM products WHERE created_at = '2025-09-20';
